# System Context and Containers {#sec-context}

## Goals and constraints

- **Goal.** Turn a clinician-selected retinal image into a reviewed, provenance-preserving dataset record. Optional model evidence may support the review, but it never replaces the clinician's decision.
- **Scope.** A research and clinical-support proof of concept for public/synthetic data and approved hospital use. It is not autonomous diagnosis, referral, or a regulated medical device.
- **Hard constraints** (enforced in code):
  - the review workstation never loads model weights (`APP_PROFILE=review` requires `MODEL_RUNTIME=remote`);
  - original admitted images are immutable;
  - human review is authoritative;
  - secrets stay server-side.

## System Context (C4 level 1)

![System Context. Source: `docs/adr/architecture/01-system-context.mmd`.](../../adr/architecture/rendered/01-system-context.png){#fig-context width=100%}

| Actor or system | Relationship |
|:----------------|:-------------|
| Clinician / reviewer | Uses the browser UI on the workstation (`127.0.0.1:8000/app/`). Owns every confirmation. |
| Project team | Receives dataset exports and monitors coverage outside the software (@sec-boundary). |
| Hospital IT / operator | Installs and runs the workstation and the GPU Model API. |
| Hospital-controlled image storage | **Not accessed by the Workbench.** Images arrive only through authorized human selection and approved staging. |
| CVAT Online | Optional dense-annotation round trip (`dr_support/cvat.py`, `dr_support/sync.py`). |
| Upstream model sources | Downloaded once during online setup, then pinned and SHA-256 verified. |

: Context relationships. {#tbl-context tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

## Containers (C4 level 2)

![Container view. Source: `docs/adr/architecture/02-container.mmd`.](../../adr/architecture/rendered/02-container.png){#fig-container width=100%}

| Container | Technology | Code |
|:----------|:-----------|:-----|
| Clinician UI | React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + Vite 5 + Chakra UI 2, served from `frontend/dist` at `/app/` | `frontend/src/**` |
| Legacy UI | Static HTML/JS at `/ui/` (compatibility only) | `web/**` |
| Review API | FastAPI app built by `dr_support.api._factory.create_app` | `dr_support/api/**`, `dr_support/workflow.py`, `dr_support/services/**` |
| Workspace review DB | SQLite, one JSON document per case (`cases(id, data)`), optimistic `revision` | `dr_support/store.py` |
| Workspace catalog | SQLite list of Workspace profiles (input, output, DB path) | `dr_support/services/workspaces.py` |
| Workspace input/output folders | File system; input is read-only in practice; output receives `dataset-export-*` | `services/admission.py`, `services/dataset.py` |
| Model API | FastAPI app from `dr_support.services.model_api.create_app` on the GPU host | `dr_support/services/model_api.py`, `dr_support/providers/**` |

: Containers. {#tbl-containers tbl-colwidths="[24,44,32]"}

One code base serves every container. `dr_support/app.py` selects the surface with `APP_PROFILE` (@sec-runtime).
